The useEffect on [user] already syncs to localStorage. Build fails only due to missing ProfilePage/ProtectedRoute (pre-existing, handled in phases 4-5). 10 tests still pass.

planPhases.title: Create ProtectedRoute component
planPhases.notes: Created src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx. Uses useAuthContext().isAuthenticated — redirects to /login with Navigate when not authenticated, renders children when authenticated. Both protectedRoute.test.tsx tests pass. Build fails only due to missing ProfilePage (phase-5).

planPhases.title: Create ProfilePage with view, edit form, and PATCH logic
planPhases.notes: Created src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx. Implements view mode (username, email, member-since date, Edit Profile button), edit form with username/email inputs (pre-filled), Change Password toggle, Save/Cancel buttons. Save sends only changed fields in PATCH, no request if unchanged. Cancel discards changes. On success calls updateUser (syncs localStorage). Shows inline error on 4xx. All 42 tests pass, build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Update App.tsx: add /profile route wrapped with ProtectedRoute
planPhases.notes: Added ProtectedRoute and ProfilePage imports to App.tsx. Added <Route path="profile" element={<ProtectedRoute><ProfilePage /></ProtectedRoute>} /> inside the AppLayout route. All 42 tests pass, build succeeds.

planPhases.title: Run all tests and verify they all pass
planPhases.notes: All 42 tests pass across 12 test files. Build also succeeds (tsc + vite). No regressions.
